_comment: Aerial basemaps for the MISSION MAP, per Gazebo world. 'affine' maps the world/PX4 local frame (x = East, y = North, metres) to texture pixels: u = a*x + b*y + c, v = d*x + e*y + f. Calibrated by spawning a downward camera at known positions in the running world and SIFT-matching its frames against the texture; 'validation_error_m' is the error at held-out positions. 'geofence_half_side_m' (optional) widens the interactive session's geofence for this world from the default 200 m; keep it inside the terrain. 'terrain' places the world's DEM (centred on home, north up, size_m = east-west, north-south) for the terrain-clearance check; fitted to Gazebo's ground with a downward depth camera at 12 points.
